subject: [PATCH v6 04/12] mm, swap: support physical swap as a vswap backend

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch adds support for physical swap as a backend for the virtual swap layer, allowing pages to be swapped out directly to physical memory when zswap declines them. The physical slot is tracked via a vswap-tagged swap_table entry on the physical cluster, and swapoff reads each vswap entry back through its rmap slot before freeing the physical slot. If zswap is disabled or the folio's cgroup is at its zswap limit, the folio gets a physical swap slot directly, bypassing vswap.
